reason: The README describes an agent tool that searches the dsh.so registry for plugins and presents ranked metadata and installation commands, making search and browsing the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 通过自然语言搜索 dsh.so 插件注册表，并返回匹配插件的说明、验证与风险信息及安装命令。
summaries.en: Searches the dsh.so plugin registry using natural-language requests and returns matching plugins with descriptions, verification and risk information, and installation commands.

capabilities: Registers an agent tool for natural-language plugin searches
Fetches and searches a configurable dsh.so plugin index
Returns plugin metadata, verification and risk labels, installation commands, and detail links
Caches index responses and applies request timeouts
